What We Do

Our Services

From a dripping faucet to a complete heating system overhaul — Northline handles it all. Every job backed by a 1-year labor warranty and our no-surprise pricing guarantee.

Available 24 Hours, 365 Days

Emergency Plumbing Repairs

Plumbing emergencies don't wait for business hours. A burst pipe, failed water heater, sewage backup, or major leak can cause serious damage within minutes. That's why Northline keeps a technician on call around the clock — every night, every weekend, every holiday.

When you call our emergency line, a live person answers. We give you an honest ETA and arrive ready to work, with a fully-stocked truck. Most emergencies are resolved in a single visit.

Emergency Services Include

  • Burst and frozen pipe repair
  • Water shutoff and damage control
  • Sewage backup emergency clearing
  • No-heat emergency boiler response
  • Gas leak isolation (call 911 first if you smell gas)
  • Sump pump failure replacement
Call Emergency Line Now

Tank & Tankless

Water Heater Installation & Repair

Cold showers, rumbling tanks, or rusty water are signs your water heater needs attention. Northline installs, repairs, and replaces both traditional tank-style units and modern tankless systems for greater efficiency.

We stock commonly-needed units on our trucks so most straightforward replacements happen same-day. We properly size the new unit for your household, permit the work where required, and haul away the old equipment at no extra charge.

Water Heater Services Include

  • Tank-style replacement (all major brands)
  • Tankless (on-demand) installation & descaling
  • Thermocouple, pilot, and burner repair
  • T&P relief valve replacement
  • Anode rod replacement
  • Expansion tank installation
Request a Water Heater Quote

All Major Brands Serviced

Boiler Maintenance & Repair

A well-maintained boiler is safe, efficient, and can last 25+ years. Neglected boilers are expensive to run and can become safety hazards. Northline provides annual boiler tune-ups to keep your system running clean through Michigan winters.

We service all major boiler brands including Weil-McLain, Burnham, Peerless, Slant/Fin, and U.S. Boiler. Whether you have a cast iron steam boiler in an older home or a modern condensing system, our technicians know the equipment.

Boiler Services Include

  • Annual maintenance & tune-up
  • Pressure relief valve testing & replacement
  • Zone valve and circulator pump repair
  • Expansion tank service
  • Bleeding and balancing radiators
  • Full boiler replacement when needed
Schedule a Boiler Tune-Up

Additions, Basements & Remodels

Bathroom Rough-In

Building a basement bathroom, adding a powder room to an addition, or remodeling an existing bath? Northline handles the plumbing rough-in work that must happen before your drywall goes up — getting drain, vent, and supply lines precisely where they need to be.

We coordinate directly with your general contractor and can handle the permit pull where required. Our rough-ins pass inspection the first time because we've been doing this work in Grand Rapids for over 37 years.

Rough-In Services Include

  • Drain, waste & vent (DWV) installation
  • Hot and cold supply line stub-outs
  • Toilet flange and wax ring set
  • Shower valve and tub drain installation
  • Permit coordination
  • Fixture trim-out after finish work
Get a Rough-In Estimate

Clogs Cleared Fast

Drain Cleaning & Hydrojetting

A slow drain is an annoyance; a fully-blocked drain is a problem that gets worse every day. Northline clears drains properly — not just punched through, but actually cleaned so they stay clear longer.

For severe buildup, tree-root intrusion, or grease-packed commercial lines, we use high-pressure hydrojetting: a 4,000 PSI water stream that scours the pipe wall clean. We also have camera equipment to inspect the line before and after.

Drain Services Include

  • Kitchen, bathroom, and floor drain clearing
  • Main line cable cleaning
  • High-pressure hydrojetting
  • Video drain inspection
  • Root intrusion treatment
Schedule Drain Service

From Cleanout to Street

Sewer Line Inspection & Repair

Sewer problems are some of the most disruptive issues a homeowner can face. Slow drains throughout the house, sewage backing up into the lowest fixture, or wet spots in the yard are warning signs your main sewer line needs attention.

Northline uses video inspection cameras to pinpoint exactly where the problem is — saving you from unnecessary digging. When repair is needed, we offer both traditional open-cut and, where soil conditions allow, trenchless repair methods.

Sewer Services Include

  • Video camera sewer inspection
  • Main line clearing and hydrojetting
  • Trenchless pipe repair (pipe lining)
  • Full sewer line replacement
  • Cleanout installation
Schedule Sewer Inspection

Licensed Gas Work

Gas Line Services

Gas line work requires a licensed plumbing contractor — and for good reason. Northline is fully licensed for natural gas piping in Michigan and handles everything from new appliance connections to full gas line replacement.

If you smell gas, leave the building immediately and call your gas company and 911. Once the situation is safe, call Northline to locate the leak, make the repair, and pressure-test the line before we leave.

Gas Line Services Include

  • Gas line leak detection and repair
  • New appliance connection (dryer, range, fireplace)
  • Gas line extension and rerouting
  • Pressure testing and certification
  • Corroded or undersized pipe replacement
Request Gas Line Service

Find It Before the Damage Spreads

Leak Detection & Repair

A hidden leak behind a wall or under a concrete slab can cause thousands of dollars in damage before you ever see water. Northline uses electronic listening equipment and thermal imaging to locate leaks without ripping out walls unnecessarily.

Once we've pinpointed the source, we give you a clear repair estimate before any work begins. Most hidden leaks can be accessed with minimal disruption — a small access panel rather than a gut renovation.

Leak Detection Services Include

  • Electronic acoustic leak detection
  • Slab leak location and repair
  • In-wall supply line leaks
  • Irrigation and outdoor supply leaks
  • Repair after detection — one call, one visit
